STEP 3 - Items: Whole almonds only.

STEP 6 - Grams: Bulk density for loose almonds is about 0.6 g/ml, so 144 x 0.6 = 86 g. Counting pieces as a check gives about 65 almonds visible, at about 1.2 g each, which is about 78 g. I'll use about 80 g.

STEP 7 - Energy: Almonds are about 579 kcal per 100 g, so 80 g gives about 463 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: A small handful to a serving of almonds (about 65 nuts) weighing about 80 g is plausible.
